column1: # The required-checks transition of the legacy/ move (R-0558, R-0563): one row per job the base's
# required-checks.txt names and this tree's does not. scripts/land/required_checks.py reads it at train
# watch and land: replacements must each be in required-checks.txt (so they run and are checked at
# the exact SHA), and `-` retires the job with a reason; a retired job is reported NOT RUN, never passed.
# "Root checks" keeps its name and is required on both sides, so it has no row. Delete a row once main
# no longer requires its job (required_checks.py reports it stale).
# N2 / R-0219 migration requirement (not a retirement/replacement row):
# Main 9cddd5891: NOT MIGRATED; whole-spec Proof vacuity is not claimed or required yet.
# Promote C10 with required PR/landing job "Proof vacuity (ConcreteSpec.Proofs.Frame)" running
# Add that job to required-checks.txt in the C10 promotion, never mark unmigrated code PASS.
# Extend required scopes cumulatively: C10; C1/C8; C4; C2/C3; C6; older proofs.
# Final promotion requires the unscoped audit. Missing migrated modules must fail.
# See scripts/proofs/README.md; no grandfather population or weakened PR checker.
